logo_recreation_blueprint.style_rules: Always render in responsive flex container with high contrast legibility over sticky header backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#08080A]/90

accessibility_fixes.hover_contrast_fix: Results and Solution tabs must NOT use low contrast hover. Set `hover:bg-[#28080E] hover:text-[#FFFFFF] data-[state=active]:bg-[#D91222] data-[state=active]:text-[#FFFFFF]` to guarantee APCA ratio > 8:1.
accessibility_fixes.sticky_nav_obscure_fix: Add `scroll-margin-top: 120px` (or `scroll-mt-28` class) to all anchor headings (.review-question, section headings) and set sticky subnav z-index to `z-20` below sticky header `z-30` so header/subnav never overlaps section title text.

source_pdf_images_rule.CRITICAL: DO NOT invert colors on source PDF images or figures! Scanned JEE Math equations, graphs, and circuit diagrams inside PDFs/images must retain their original white background and dark text inside a clean high-contrast container.
source_pdf_images_rule.container_style: bg-white p-3 rounded-lg border border-zinc-200 shadow-md inline-block max-w-full overflow-x-auto my-2

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Enforce sitewide Obsidian Black and Blood Red styling across index.css and App.css.
2. Render recreated Vector SVG Logo (JEELIVE.AI) matching the supplied asset aesthetics with zero blurred image crops.
3. Keep white/light background for source PDF math figures/images; NEVER color-invert them.
4. Fix selected Results/solution tabs hover contrast to APCA > 8:1 and add scroll-margin-top: 120px on review questions to prevent sticky nav overlap.
5. Ensure all data-testid attributes are preserved for automated test validation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not break existing exam player state machine, timing mechanisms, or score calculation engines.
Maintain strict text contrast and clean dark mode hierarchy across all routes.
Pass all tests and preserve existing data selectors.
